static_dimensions.description: A static categorical attribute indicating the primary psychiatric diagnosis of the user in the CBT session.
A static categorical attribute describing the predominant OCD theme(s) for the user.
A static categorical attribute reflecting the user's age and developmental level relevant to CBT protocols.
A static categorical attribute indicating the user's level of recognition regarding the irrational or excessive nature of their OCD symptoms during a session.
A static categorical attribute describing the historical course of OCD symptoms.
A static categorical attribute capturing the user's previous experience with OCD treatment.
A static categorical attribute capturing the degree of family or social accommodation/participation in rituals and the support system.
A static categorical attribute denoting presence of other psychiatric or medical disorders that may impact CBT sessions.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state indicating the current severity of OCD symptoms (obsessions, compulsions, distress, impairment) during the session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes with session progress, exposure tasks, stress, and between-session events as measured by severity scales, therapist ratings, or user self-report.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting the user's willingness to participate in and adhere to CBT tasks, including exposures, homework, and resistance to rituals.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updated in response to the user's emotional reactions, progress, clarity of rationale provided, support, and perceived difficulty of therapeutic tasks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting the user's ability to tolerate anxiety/distress during exposure or ritual prevention.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes during and across sessions depending on exposure difficulty, support, habituation, new stressors, and perceived success.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state indicating how often the user is performing rituals/compulsions during the treatment period.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes in response to exposure/response prevention, progress, stress, and social support changes.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting the extent of the user's avoidance behaviors related to OCD triggers.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: May decrease with successful exposure or increase if exposures are avoided or if distress is too high; updated throughout therapy.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state reflecting the user's trust in the therapist, treatment rationale, and perceived efficacy.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes with therapist consistency, empathy, outcomes, and satisfaction with session; can improve with positive experience or worsen after setbacks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state describing the user's predominant emotional response during the session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updates in real time as the user responds to exposures, homework, discussion, therapist interventions, and external stressors.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state assessing the user's stage of readiness for engagement in exposure or behavioral change.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes with user progress in therapy, degree of habituation, self-efficacy, and therapist feedback; may regress with setbacks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state indicating the user's observed or reported adherence to therapeutic recommendations (e.g., exposures, homework).
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Updates after feedback on homework, session attendance, therapist review, or new avoidance/substitution behaviors.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state describing the current level and valence of involvement by family or support network in therapy and rituals.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Can shift following therapist-family interventions, changes in ritual accommodation, or crises/conflicts emerging in the social context.
